subject: Ciências da Natureza e suas Tecnologias
description_pt: Realizar previsões qualitativas e quantitativas sobre o funcionamento de geradores, motores elétricos e seus componentes, bobinas, transformadores, pilhas, baterias e dispositivos eletrônicos, com base na análise dos processos de transformação e condução de energia envolvidos - com ou sem o uso de dispositivos e aplicativos digitais -, para propor ações que visem a sustentabilidade.

components.description_pt: Identificar processos de transformação de energia em geradores, motores, transformadores, baterias e dispositivos eletrônicos
components.description_en: Identify energy transformation processes occurring in generators, motors, transformers, batteries, and electronic devices
components.cc_component_description: Identify energy transformations that occur when electric current produces motion, sound, heat, or light

components.description_pt: Fazer previsões qualitativas sobre operação de dispositivos eletromagnéticos baseadas em princípios de transformação de energia
components.description_en: Make qualitative predictions about the operation of electromagnetic devices based on energy transformation principles
components.cc_component_description: Trace the energy transformation pathway from mechanical motion through electrical current to a useful output

components.description_pt: Fazer previsões quantitativas sobre comportamento de componentes elétricos como bobinas e transformadores
components.description_en: Make quantitative predictions about the behavior of electrical components such as coils and transformers
components.cc_component_description: Use mathematical representations to describe the behavior of a phenomenon quantitatively

components.description_pt: Propor ações visando sustentabilidade baseadas em análise de uso de energia em dispositivos elétricos e eletrônicos
components.description_en: Propose actions aimed at sustainability based on analysis of energy use in electrical and electronic devices
components.cc_component_description: Evaluate trade-offs between renewable and nonrenewable energy use in terms of environmental effects

cc_matches.description: Energy can also be transferred from place to place by electric currents, which can then be used locally to produce motion, sound, heat, or light. The currents may have been produced to begin with by transforming the energy of motion into electrical energy.
Use mathematical, computational, and/or algorithmic representations of phenomena or design solutions to describe and/or support claims and/or explanations.
Energy and fuels that humans use are derived from natural sources, and their use affects the environment in multiple ways. Some resources are renewable over time, and others are not.
